name: razorveda-crm
description: Internal CRM & MIS automation platform for Razorveda

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/metrics/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @razorveda/api" "npm run dev -w @razorveda/web" "npm run dev -w @razorveda/worker"
